title: Choose the visual world for the Clinic System
question: The roll assigned Modern Logistics. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Modern Logistics Tracking
options.thesis: The clinic workflow tracks a patient exactly like a parcel moving through operational stages.
options.viewport: Horizontal tracking timeline at the top, distinct work area for the current stage.
options.risk: Might feel too industrial for a medical setting.

raised.raise: Patient history adopts structured, book-like typography.
Strict grid density and real-time readouts for lab results.

options.label: Mass Transit Map
options.thesis: Patients navigate through predefined colored 'lines' representing OPDs and services.
options.viewport: A map-like overview of the clinic showing patient volume at each station.
options.case: Excellent for routing multiple patients, but less focused on the individual's linear journey.
options.risk: Can become visually overwhelming when many patients are present.

options.label: Encyclopedia of Life
options.thesis: Every patient is a detailed, cross-referenced entry in a vast medical catalog.
options.case: Loses on product clarity: this is an operational workflow app, not just a reference library.
options.kept: Structured, book-like typography for history records.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: High-density data readouts with real-time continuous sliders.
options.case: Too abstract and not aligned with medical workflow constraints.
options.kept: Strict grid density and real-time readouts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Side rail nav, table of patients, and a detail pane.
